Interface Directory

All Superinterfaces:
CapabilityProvider
All Known Subinterfaces:
WritableDirectory
All Known Implementing Classes:
DiskFileStoreAdapter.DiskDirectoryAdapter, GamedosDirectory, ShrinkitDirectory, ZipDirectory
public interface Directory extends CapabilityProvider
A Directory represents a directory in a FileStore. Note that even file stores that don't naturally support a directory do contain a root directory, so there will be a directory associated to each FileStore.
